title: A test: nickel ore gathered at Long Errand Band (Jadecove, lawless) into storage at The Crescent Moon (Mebsuta, four jumps)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-17 23:16 UTC (orders.log ENT-050, block ZERO: gold and nickel where a field has them; rules F3, F13, F24). Long Errand Band read 1,745 nickel ore of 20,000 at richness 40 (table fields, 18:15 UTC); the reserve is short 15,486 nickel ore and holds 2,834 (surplus.py reserve, 23:04 UTC). No field nearer our stations holds nickel above 1,300 without a pirate record (Gliese 876: 37 battles on file). The nearest storage is The Crescent Moon in Mebsuta, four jumps, where the silicon test of Floodlight Flats stores too; no pirate observation in Jadecove or beside it in 24 hours (observations, 23:15 UTC). Stores everything, sells nothing (rule F24). One ship with an empty hold until its first RESULT line (rules F8, F13). 2026-11-21 19:38 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 1 -> 3. 15:10 UTC (Zero, orders ENT-064 block ZERO: loads go to the receivers by gift; requests ENT-350, ENT-351): gift to the hauler Apollo named at this station (data/fleet/receivers.json): with strict classes on each run docks, stores and gives the reserve's ores of its hold and of the pilot's storage there to Logistics, which crafts them where they lie.
